changes.why: The article's own health quantities are single-group summaries of cases; the chlorine log count (2 vs 15 expected readings) is an inspection compliance finding, not a health outcome. No exposed-versus-unexposed or other group contrast is computed.
No health outcome is compared across groups or against a fixed referent; national outbreak counts are cited context from reference 5.
SNP analysis of two isolates is a laboratory method that links cases to a common exposure; it does not produce or qualify an analyzed quantity, so it is not a procedure under the brief.
